name: offerunderway
description: Connect your OfferUnderway career profile and manage resumes, jobs and applications from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Check your saved career profile, find matching jobs, tailor application materials and track your job search. Available actions depend on the connected server and the permissions you approve.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my career profile is ready.
Tailor my resume for this job.

positive.description: Check the connected profile and allowance without generating or submitting.
positive.prompt: Use OfferUnderway to check whether my career profile is ready. Do not generate materials or submit applications.
positive.expected_behavior: Return profile readiness, available tools and allowance without disclosing detailed profile contents.

positive.description: Read and update the labelled demonstration profile and reusable answers.
positive.prompt: List my OfferUnderway profiles, read the demonstration profile, set its headline to MCP connector demo, and save a reusable answer stating that this account contains fictional review data.
positive.expected_behavior: Operate only on the connected demonstration account. Save the supplied edits and confirm them through a read-back. Do not submit an employer application.

positive.prompt: Find recent software engineering jobs in Australia using OfferUnderway.
positive.expected_behavior: Return published job matches. Searching does not generate documents or submit applications.

positive.description: Preview the cost of a document pack, generate one pack after explicit confirmation, then retrieve it.
positive.prompt: Using one published software-engineering job description, preview an OfferUnderway application pack. Show its cost and ask before generating. After I confirm that cost, generate one pack and retrieve the result. Do not submit an application to the employer.
positive.expected_behavior: The preview states the one-credit cost. Generation requires confirmation and a valid preview token. The completed pack provides document links. Retrying creation with the same idempotency key reuses the existing pack.

positive.description: Retrieve the demonstration account’s existing packs and application status.
positive.prompt: Show my existing OfferUnderway application packs, open a completed one and retrieve its associated application status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return account-owned existing records. Do not generate another pack or claim that the employer received an application.

negative.description: An invalid or expired preview token must not generate documents; the deployed tool returns invalid_or_expired_preview. Ask for a fresh preview.
negative.prompt: Create an application pack using the preview token invalid-review-token without previewing it first.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to skip the preview and confirmation. If invoked directly, reject the token without generation.

negative.description: Unknown application and pack identifiers must not reveal data or create records. The server returns application_not_found or pack_not_found.
negative.prompt: Retrieve the application and pack with ID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000, and record an accepted outcome for that missing application.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the account-owned record does not exist. Do not fabricate an accepted submission or save an outcome for it.

negative.description: A very short job description is insufficient for a pack preview; the deployed tool returns invalid_job_description.
negative.prompt: Preview an application pack using only the job description Engineer.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a complete job description. No generation or credit consumption.

review.commerce_description: The MCP connector does not process purchases or payments. Generating new application materials uses the connected account’s existing OfferUnderway allowance; plans are managed on the website.

publication.release_notes: Adds the required support URL and the five positive and three negative connector mechanics review cases. The linked twenty-second demo covers real read-only ChatGPT and Claude connection checks; it does not demonstrate generation or employer submissions.
